newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse shares up, turnover down.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse shares up, turnover down.

text.p: The average prices of the bulk of Bucharest stocks rose on Thursday under buying pressure, traders said.
"Demand stayed rather high and I don't think the picture is going to change on Friday," said one.

Three independent market indices, the VAB, the BIG and the CAS-SE, all based on average prices and market capitalisation, climbed to new highs for the year, rising by 1.85, 2.12 and 1.84 respectively from the previous session.
Volume was 2.5 million shares -- slightly down from 2.7 million on Thursday -- on turnover of 10 billion lei, 1.8 billion lei down from the previous session.
The first tier once again accounted for most of turnover -- or 78 percent.

Three of the seven stocks in this section saw higher average prices, one fell and two stayed flat. Arctic refrigerator maker remained suspended. Four of the high-caps also closed higher as buying pressure built up towards the end of the session, operators said.

Fertiliser makers Azomures and Sofert gained 100 and 1,000 lei respectively to close at 3,700 and 31,000. Chemical plant Oltchim firmed 50 lei to a 3,350 close and Antibiotice pharmaceuticals ended 150 lei stronger at 7,100.
The other pharmaceuticals company, Terapia, stayed flat at 7,000, while Compa vehicle parts maker slipped 200 lei to end at 3,200.
A trader said that Compa, which gained 26 percent on its average price, lost in late trading due to a deal involving larger volumes.
Traders said they expected first-tier stocks would remain unchanged at Friday's session.
Policolor dye maker was the second tier's star, with more than one billion lei in turnover and a close quote 100 lei firmer at 6,450.
